record.context_brief: Equivalence of two multilinear Schatten scales
record.original_question: Let S_p denote the trilinear-form classes defined by the first method, and let S~_p denote the classes defined by approximation numbers s_n(B), namely by requiring the sequence {s_n(B)} to lie in l^p. For compact trilinear forms on Hilbert spaces, is it true that S_p = S~_p for 0 < p <= infinity?

evidence.quote: But is it true that S_p = S~_p?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_1, H_2, H_3$ be separable Hilbert spaces and let $B \colon H_1 \times H_2 \times H_3 \to \mathbb{C}$ be a bounded trilinear form. 

Two scales of "Schatten–von Neumann" classes for such trilinear forms are considered.

(1) (Decomposition scale $\mathfrak{S}_p$.) For $0 < p \le \infty$, define $\mathfrak{S}_p$ to be the class of compact trilinear forms $B$ that admit a representation
$$B(x,y,z) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \lambda_n \langle x, e_n\rangle \, \langle y, f_n\rangle \, \langle z, g_n\rangle,$$
where $\{e_n\} \subset H_1$, $\{f_n\}\subset H_2$, $\{g_n\}\subset H_3$ are orthonormal systems and $\{\lambda_n\} \in \ell^p$ (with the usual interpretation for $p=\infty$, replaced by $c_0$ for compactness). The corresponding quasi-norm is the infimum of $\|\{\lambda_n\}\|_{\ell^p}$ over all such representations.

(2) (Approximation-number scale $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_p$.) For a compact trilinear form $B$, define the $n$-th approximation number
$$s_n(B) = \inf\{\|B - B_n\| : B_n \text{ is a trilinear form of rank} < n\},$$
where rank is the smallest $k$ such that $B_n$ admits a representation as above with $k$ summands and $\|\cdot\|$ is the operator (sup) norm on the unit polydisk of $H_1\times H_2\times H_3$. Define $\widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_p$ to consist of those compact $B$ such that $\{s_n(B)\}_{n\ge 1} \in \ell^p$.

Question: Is it true that $\mathfrak{S}_p = \widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_p$ for every $0 < p \le \infty$?
artifact.status_search_result: A series of works by Cobos, Kühn, and Peetre develops the theory of Schatten–von Neumann classes for trilinear forms on Hilbert spaces, including the $\mathfrak{G}_p$-classes and embedding constants, but I could not locate a definitive published result establishing or refuting the equality $\mathfrak{S}_p = \widetilde{\mathfrak{S}}_p$ for all $0 < p \le \infty$. The question appears to remain unresolved in the literature accessible via search.

status_evidence.title: On Gp-classes of trilinear forms
status_evidence.snippet: Continues research laying the foundations of a theory of Schatten–von Neumann classes of trilinear forms in Hilbert space.
status_evidence.claim: Active research line by Cobos, Kühn, Peetre on Schatten-type classes of trilinear forms, with no explicit resolution of the S_p = S~_p equivalence.

status_evidence.title: Singular Values of Trilinear Forms (Bernhardsson and Peetre)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies singular values/approximation numbers of trilinear forms.
status_evidence.claim: Related study of singular values does not appear to settle the general equivalence question.
